question: Proverbs 26:4 says not to answer a fool according to his folly. What does verse 5 add?
options: Never speak to a fool at all
Answer a fool according to his folly, or he will be wise in his own eyes
Ask the king to answer the fool
explanation: Verse 4 warns that answering a fool can make you like him, while verse 5 says to answer him so he will not be wise in his own eyes; wisdom knows when each applies.
